notes: The GoPro Quik app is no longer needed. A HERO9 keeps its WiFi switched off until an app asks over Bluetooth, and FlightPath now sends that request itself using GoPro's own published protocol. The Camera step is one button: Turn on camera WiFi and connect. It wakes the camera, reads its network name and password off the camera, and joins it. The first time, put the camera on Preferences, Connections, Connect Device, GoPro App so it pairs with the phone, and accept the pairing request; after that just leave the camera on its shooting screen.
